  fn spend(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    budget.department_spend(store, dept.id, period)

  fn statement(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    let rows: Rows = []
    for r in rs
      if r is reports.Counted then
        let st: audit.Step = if r.status in {reports.ReportStatus.Paid} then audit.Step.Paid else audit.Step.Approved
        rows = rows ++ [{ id: r.id, badge: r.badge, status: st, total: lines.total(r.lines), budgeted: lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) }]
    let advs: advances.Advances = store.advances_for(dept.id, period)?
    for a in advs
      if a is advances.Counted then
        let st: audit.Step = if a.status in {advances.AdvanceStatus.Paid} then audit.Step.Paid else audit.Step.Approved
        rows = rows ++ [{ id: a.id, badge: a.badge, status: st, total: a.amount, budgeted: a.amount }]

  fn outstanding_advances(store, today) =
    let paid: advances.Advances = store.paid_advances()?
    let out: Ids = []
    for a in paid
      if advances.outstanding(a, today) then out = out ++ [a.id]
    Ok(out)

    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.submitted_reports()?
    let out: Ids = []
    if who is staff.Active then

        if r is reports.Submitted and r.badge != who.badge then
          let verdict: Outcome<Bool> = review.may_act(store, r, who)
          if verdict is Ok then

  fn grant_delegation(store, reg, delegator, delegate, first, last) =
    let giver: staff.Staff = store.staff(delegator)?
    if giver is staff.Active and giver.role in {ids.Role.Supervisor, ids.Role.Director} then
      let taker: staff.Staff = store.staff(delegate)?
      if taker is staff.Active then
        if delegate != delegator and first <= last and last - first <= 11 then
          let existing: records.Delegations = reg.delegations_from(delegator)?
          if any d in existing where not d.revoked and d.first <= last and first <= d.last then
            Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "an existing delegation overlaps these periods")
          else
            let id: records.DelegationId = store.next_id()?
            reg.save_delegation({ id: id, delegator: delegator, delegate: delegate, first: first, last: last, revoked: false })?
            Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a delegation goes to someone else, over 1 to 12 periods in order")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "the delegate is not active")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only an active supervisor or director may delegate")

  fn revoke_delegation(store, reg, delegation_id, badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let d: records.Delegation = reg.delegation(delegation_id)?
      if d.delegator == badge then
        if not d.revoked then reg.save_delegation(d with { revoked: true })
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the delegation is already revoked")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the delegator may revoke a delegation")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn delegate_in_force(reg, badge, period) =
    let ds: records.Delegations = reg.delegations_from(badge)?
    let found: Maybe<ids.Badge> = None
    for d in ds
      if records.in_force(d, period) then found = d.delegate
    Ok(found)

  fn pay(store, ledger, report_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then

  fn pay_advance(store, ledger, advance_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let a: advances.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if a is advances.Approved then
        let reference: Text = ledger.pay(a.badge, a.amount, a.id)?
        store.save_advance(advances.pay(a, reference))?

    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      let a: advances.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if r is reports.Approved then

            let reference: Text = if due > 0 then ledger.pay(r.badge, due, r.id)? else a.reference
            store.save_report(reports.pay(r, reference))?

            store.save_advance(advances.settle(a, if due > 0 then 0 else 0 - due))?
            store.append_audit(audit.advance_entry(who.badge, a.id, advances.AdvanceStatus.Paid, advances.AdvanceStatus.Settled, "settled"))?

    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

    if who is staff.Finance then

      if closed then Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is already closed")
      else store.close_period(period)

module desk.review
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.lines as lines
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.audit as audit
import desk.host as host
import desk.routing as routing
import desk.budget as budget

interface
  fn open_draft(store: host.Store, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period, first_line: lines.Line) -> Outcome<ids.ReportId>
  fn add_line(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, line: lines.Line) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn submit(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn approve(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<reports.ReportStatus>
  fn reject(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, approver: ids.Badge, reason: ids.Reason) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn request_changes(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, approver: ids.Badge, reason: ids.Reason) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn resubmit(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>

  fn may_act(store: host.Store, r: reports.Submitted, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
  fn may_act_on(store: host.Store, submitter: ids.Badge, department: ids.DepartmentId, step: Int, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
private
  type Gate = { r: reports.Submitted, who: staff.Active }
  type Own  = { r: reports.Report, who: staff.Active }

  fn gate(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Gate>
  fn own(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Own>
  fn open_and_valid(store: host.Store, r: reports.Report) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn required_for(store: host.Store, submitter: ids.Badge, department: ids.DepartmentId, step: Int) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>
  fn stand_in(store: host.Store, required: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>

  fn open_draft(store, badge, period, first_line) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
      if not closed then
        let id: ids.ReportId = store.next_id()?
        store.save_report({ id: id, badge: badge, department: who.department, period: period, lines: [first_line], status: reports.ReportStatus.Draft, approvals: [] })?
        Ok(id)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn add_line(store, report_id, badge, line) =
    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
    if o.r is reports.Editable then
      if o.r.lines.length < 50 then store.save_report(reports.add_line(o.r, line))
      else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a report holds at most 50 lines")
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not editable")

  fn submit(store, report_id, badge) =
    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
    if o.r is reports.Draft then
      open_and_valid(store, o.r)?
      store.save_report(reports.submit(o.r))?
      store.append_audit(audit.report_entry(badge, o.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Draft, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, "submitted"))
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not a draft")

  fn resubmit(store, report_id, badge) =
    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
    if o.r is reports.AwaitingChanges then
      open_and_valid(store, o.r)?
      store.save_report(reports.resubmit(o.r))?
      store.append_audit(audit.report_entry(badge, o.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, "resubmitted"))
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not awaiting changes")

  fn approve(store, report_id, approver) =
    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
    if g.r.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(lines.total(g.r.lines)) then final_approval(store, g.r, g.who)
    else
      store.save_report(reports.add_approval(g.r, g.who.badge))?
      store.append_audit(audit.report_entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, "approved; awaiting the next approver"))?
      Ok(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted)

  fn reject(store, report_id, approver, reason) =
    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
    store.save_report(reports.reject(g.r))?
    store.append_audit(audit.report_entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Rejected, reason))

  fn request_changes(store, report_id, approver, reason) =
    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
    store.save_report(reports.request_changes(g.r))?
    store.append_audit(audit.report_entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested, reason))

  fn own(store, report_id, badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r.badge == badge then Ok({ r: r, who: who })
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the submitter may act on this report")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn open_and_valid(store, r) =
    let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(r.period)?
    if closed then Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
    else if lines.all_valid(r.lines) then Ok(Done)
    else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a line is over its limit or lacks a required receipt")

  fn gate(store, report_id, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r is reports.Submitted then
        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(r.period)?
        if not closed then
          if who.badge != r.badge then
            let allowed: Bool = may_act(store, r, who)?
            if allowed then Ok({ r: r, who: who })
            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this report's next approver")
          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "a report cannot be approved by its submitter")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not awaiting approval")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn may_act(store, r, who) = may_act_on(store, r.badge, r.department, r.approvals.length + 1, who)

  fn may_act_on(store, submitter, department, step, who) =
    let required: Maybe<ids.Badge> = required_for(store, submitter, department, step)?
    if required == None then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
    else Ok(who.badge == required)

  fn required_for(store, submitter, department, step) =
    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(step)
    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(None)
    else if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
      let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(submitter)?

      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the submitter has no supervisor")

      let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?

    let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(required)?
    if person.active then Ok(required)
    else if person.supervisor != None then
      let up: staff.Staff = store.staff(person.supervisor)?
      if up.active then Ok(person.supervisor)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)

  fn final_approval(store, r, who) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(r.department)?
    let spent: Int = budget.department_spend(store, r.department, r.period)?
    let within: Bool = spent + lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) <= dept.budget
    if within or who.role in {ids.Role.Finance} then
      let reason: ids.Reason = if within then "approved" else "approved; budget override"
      store.save_report(reports.approve(r))?
      store.append_audit(audit.report_entry(who.badge, r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Approved, reason))?
      Ok(reports.ReportStatus.Approved)
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the department budget for this period would be exceeded")

  fn spend(store: host.Store, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Int>
  fn outstanding_advances(store: host.Store, today: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Ids>
  fn pending_for(store: host.Store, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Ids>
body
  fn spend(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    budget.department_spend(store, dept.id, period)

  fn statement(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    let rows: Rows = []
    for r in rs
      if r is reports.Counted then
        let st: audit.Step = if r.status in {reports.ReportStatus.Paid} then audit.Step.Paid else audit.Step.Approved
        rows = rows ++ [{ id: r.id, badge: r.badge, status: st, total: lines.total(r.lines), budgeted: lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) }]
    let advs: advances.Advances = store.advances_for(dept.id, period)?
    for a in advs
      if a is advances.Counted then
        let st: audit.Step = if a.status in {advances.AdvanceStatus.Paid} then audit.Step.Paid else audit.Step.Approved
        rows = rows ++ [{ id: a.id, badge: a.badge, status: st, total: a.amount, budgeted: a.amount }]
    let spent: Int = budget.spend_of(rs, advs)
    Ok({ department: dept.id, period: period, budget: dept.budget, spend: spent, remaining: dept.budget - spent, rows: rows })

  fn outstanding_advances(store, today) =
    let paid: advances.Advances = store.paid_advances()?
    let out: Ids = []
    for a in paid
      if advances.outstanding(a, today) then out = out ++ [a.id]
    Ok(out)

  fn pending_for(store, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.submitted_reports()?
    let out: Ids = []
    if who is staff.Active then
      for r in rs
        if r is reports.Submitted and r.badge != who.badge then
          let verdict: Outcome<Bool> = review.may_act(store, r, who)
          if verdict is Ok then
            let allowed: Bool = verdict?
            if allowed then out = out ++ [r.id]
    Ok(out)

interface

  fn revoke_delegation(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, delegation_id: records.DelegationId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>

body
  fn grant_delegation(store, reg, delegator, delegate, first, last) =
    let giver: staff.Staff = store.staff(delegator)?
    if giver is staff.Active and giver.role in {ids.Role.Supervisor, ids.Role.Director} then
      let taker: staff.Staff = store.staff(delegate)?
      if taker is staff.Active then
        if delegate != delegator and first <= last and last - first <= 11 then
          let existing: records.Delegations = reg.delegations_from(delegator)?
          if any d in existing where not d.revoked and d.first <= last and first <= d.last then
            Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "an existing delegation overlaps these periods")
          else
            let id: records.DelegationId = store.next_id()?
            reg.save_delegation({ id: id, delegator: delegator, delegate: delegate, first: first, last: last, revoked: false })?
            Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a delegation goes to someone else, over 1 to 12 periods in order")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "the delegate is not active")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only an active supervisor or director may delegate")

  fn revoke_delegation(store, reg, delegation_id, badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let d: records.Delegation = reg.delegation(delegation_id)?
      if d.delegator == badge then
        if not d.revoked then reg.save_delegation(d with { revoked: true })
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the delegation is already revoked")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the delegator may revoke a delegation")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn delegate_in_force(reg, badge, period) =
    let ds: records.Delegations = reg.delegations_from(badge)?
    let found: Maybe<ids.Badge> = None
    for d in ds
      if records.in_force(d, period) then found = d.delegate
    Ok(found)

# desk/purchasing.brass
module desk.purchasing
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.routing as routing
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host
import desk.registry as registry
import desk.delegation as delegation

interface
  fn raise_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, badge: ids.Badge, vendor_id: records.VendorId, amount: Int, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<records.PoId>
  fn approve_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<records.PoStatus>
  fn reject_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn receive_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, badge: ids.Badge, received_amount: Int) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn close_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn po_commitments(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Int>
private
  type PoGate = { po: records.PoRequested, who: staff.Active }
  fn gate(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<PoGate>
  fn accepted(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po: records.PoRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
  fn required_person(store: host.Store, po: records.PoRequested) -> Outcome<ids.Badge>
body
  fn raise_po(store, reg, badge, vendor_id, amount, period) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let v: records.Vendor = reg.vendor(vendor_id)?
      if v.active then
        if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 then
          let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
          if not closed then
            let id: records.PoId = store.next_id()?
            reg.save_po({ id: id, vendor: vendor_id, requested_by: badge, department: who.department, period: period, amount: amount, status: records.PoStatus.Requested, approvals: [], received: 0 })?
            Ok(id)
          else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a PO is for at least 1 cent")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the vendor is not active")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn approve_po(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
    let g: PoGate = gate(store, reg, po_id, approver)?
    if g.po.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(g.po.amount) then
      let limit: ids.Money = reg.allowance(g.po.department, g.po.period)?
      let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_for(g.po.department, g.po.period)?
      if records.commitments(pos) + g.po.amount <= limit then
        reg.save_po(records.approve_po(g.po))?
        Ok(records.PoStatus.Approved)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the department's PO allowance for this period would be exceeded")
    else
      reg.save_po(records.add_po_approval(g.po, g.who.badge))?
      Ok(records.PoStatus.Requested)

  fn reject_po(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
    let g: PoGate = gate(store, reg, po_id, approver)?
    reg.save_po(records.reject_po(g.po))

  fn receive_po(store, reg, po_id, badge, received_amount) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
      if po.requested_by == badge then
        if po is records.PoApproved then
          if received_amount >= 1 and received_amount <= po.amount then reg.save_po(records.receive_po(po, received_amount))
          else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "the received amount is 1 to the PO's amount")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not approved")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the requester may receive a PO")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn close_po(store, reg, po_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
      if po is records.PoReceived then reg.save_po(records.close_po(po))
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not received")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may close a PO")

  fn po_commitments(store, reg, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_for(dept.id, period)?
    Ok(records.commitments(pos))

  fn gate(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
      if po is records.PoRequested then
        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(po.period)?
        if not closed then
          if who.badge != po.requested_by then
            let ok: Bool = accepted(store, reg, po, who)?
            if ok then Ok({ po: po, who: who })
            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this PO's next approver")
          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "a PO cannot be approved by its requester")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not awaiting approval")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn accepted(store, reg, po, who) =
    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(po.approvals.length + 1)
    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
    else
      let required: ids.Badge = required_person(store, po)?
      let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(required)?
      let deputy: Maybe<ids.Badge> = delegation.delegate_in_force(reg, required, po.period)?
      if person.active then Ok(who.badge == required or (deputy != None and who.badge == deputy))
      else if deputy != None then Ok(who.badge == deputy)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the required approver is inactive and has no delegate")

  fn required_person(store, po) =
    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(po.approvals.length + 1)
    if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
      let requester: staff.Staff = store.staff(po.requested_by)?
      if requester.supervisor != None then Ok(requester.supervisor)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the requester has no supervisor")
    else
      let dept: staff.Department = store.department(po.department)?
      Ok(dept.director)

# desk/cards.brass
module desk.cards
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host
import desk.registry as registry

interface
  type TxnIds = Array<records.TxnId> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  fn import_txn(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, finance_badge: ids.Badge, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period, amount: Int, category: ids.Category, merchant: Text) -> Outcome<records.TxnId>
  fn match_txn(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, txn_id: records.TxnId, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn dispute_txn(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, txn_id: records.TxnId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn unmatched(reg: registry.Registry, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<TxnIds>
private
  type Matchable = reports.Report where it.status in {reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Approved, reports.ReportStatus.Paid}
body
  fn import_txn(store, reg, finance_badge, badge, period, amount, category, merchant) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let holder: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
      if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 and merchant.length >= 1 and merchant.length <= 200 then
        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
        if not closed then
          let id: records.TxnId = store.next_id()?
          reg.save_txn({ id: id, badge: holder.badge, period: period, amount: amount, category: category, merchant: merchant, status: records.CardStatus.Open, matched: None })?
          Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
      else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "an amount of at least 1 cent and a merchant of 1 to 200 characters")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may import card transactions")

  fn match_txn(store, reg, txn_id, report_id, badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let t: records.CardTxn = reg.txn(txn_id)?
      if t.badge == badge then
        if t is records.OpenTxn then
          let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
          if r.badge == badge then
            if r.period == t.period then
              if r is Matchable then

import desk.ids as ids
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.routing as routing

interface
  fn raise_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, badge: ids.Badge, vendor_id: records.VendorId, amount: Int, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<records.PoId>

  fn reject_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn receive_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, badge: ids.Badge, received_amount: Int) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn close_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn po_commitments(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Int>
private
  type PoGate = { po: records.PoRequested, who: staff.Active }
  fn gate(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<PoGate>
  fn accepted(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po: records.PoRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
  fn required_person(store: host.Store, po: records.PoRequested) -> Outcome<ids.Badge>
body
  fn raise_po(store, reg, badge, vendor_id, amount, period) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let v: records.Vendor = reg.vendor(vendor_id)?
      if v.active then
        if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 then
          let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
          if not closed then
            let id: records.PoId = store.next_id()?
            reg.save_po({ id: id, vendor: vendor_id, requested_by: badge, department: who.department, period: period, amount: amount, status: records.PoStatus.Requested, approvals: [], received: 0 })?
            Ok(id)
          else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a PO is for at least 1 cent")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the vendor is not active")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn approve_po(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
    let g: PoGate = gate(store, reg, po_id, approver)?
    if g.po.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(g.po.amount) then
      let limit: ids.Money = reg.allowance(g.po.department, g.po.period)?
      let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_for(g.po.department, g.po.period)?
      if records.commitments(pos) + g.po.amount <= limit then
        reg.save_po(records.approve_po(g.po))?
        Ok(records.PoStatus.Approved)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the department's PO allowance for this period would be exceeded")
    else
      reg.save_po(records.add_po_approval(g.po, g.who.badge))?
      Ok(records.PoStatus.Requested)

  fn reject_po(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
    let g: PoGate = gate(store, reg, po_id, approver)?
    reg.save_po(records.reject_po(g.po))

  fn receive_po(store, reg, po_id, badge, received_amount) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
      if po.requested_by == badge then
        if po is records.PoApproved then
          if received_amount >= 1 and received_amount <= po.amount then reg.save_po(records.receive_po(po, received_amount))
          else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "the received amount is 1 to the PO's amount")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not approved")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the requester may receive a PO")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn close_po(store, reg, po_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
      if po is records.PoReceived then reg.save_po(records.close_po(po))
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not received")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may close a PO")

  fn po_commitments(store, reg, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_for(dept.id, period)?
    Ok(records.commitments(pos))

  fn gate(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
      if po is records.PoRequested then
        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(po.period)?
        if not closed then
          if who.badge != po.requested_by then
            let ok: Bool = accepted(store, reg, po, who)?
            if ok then Ok({ po: po, who: who })
            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this PO's next approver")
          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "a PO cannot be approved by its requester")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not awaiting approval")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn accepted(store, reg, po, who) =
    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(po.approvals.length + 1)
    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
    else
      let required: ids.Badge = required_person(store, po)?
      let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(required)?
      let deputy: Maybe<ids.Badge> = delegation.delegate_in_force(reg, required, po.period)?
      if person.active then Ok(who.badge == required or (deputy != None and who.badge == deputy))
      else if deputy != None then Ok(who.badge == deputy)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the required approver is inactive and has no delegate")

  fn required_person(store, po) =
    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(po.approvals.length + 1)
    if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
      let requester: staff.Staff = store.staff(po.requested_by)?
      if requester.supervisor != None then Ok(requester.supervisor)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the requester has no supervisor")
    else
      let dept: staff.Department = store.department(po.department)?
      Ok(dept.director)
